text:
emily: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem. We need concrete owners + recurrence so this class of regressions stops reappearing. My suggested split: (A) test-harness + scenario families, (B) eviction-edge prompt bank with metadata, (C) soak + micro-chaos runbook + dashboards. Who takes which?
oscar: I can own (A) the harness. Plan: implement runner + 40 scenario families (prefix overlap, history-trim races, token aliasing). All runs must be deterministic with seeds. ETA 11 days.
nora: I'll take (B) the prompt bank. Will curate ~200 prompts, tag by pattern/sensitivity/model-variant, and include expected token-level diffs. Deliver in 8 days and attach CSV with seeds.
liam: Ops will own (C): soak + micro-chaos, dashboards, and a rollback play. I'll schedule a staging dry run and capture traces. Dry run request: next Tue morning.
emily: Please add measurable pass/fail criteria. For soak: 25m at 1.15x prod 99th, add a 12s synthetic spike; pass if fallback <0.8%, 95p latency delta <22%, KV miss multiplier <3x.
liam: Noted  will add those metrics to the runbook and surface them on the incident dashboard.
oscar: CI plan: presubmit tiny-run for PRs touching KV/cache, sampled nightly (small+med), and a full sweep weekly. I'll make the presubmit fast (<90s) and add cost caps.
emily: Also want PR gating for KV-sensitive paths. Oscar, can you add a presubmit matcher that fails PRs touching those areas unless they pass the tiny-run?
oscar: Yep. Example globs: "components/serving/kv/**", "pkg/cache/**", "services/router/**". Presubmit runs small scenario subset; if infra flakes, it annotates but still blocks until flaky-run policy is reviewed.
aditi: I'll draft a short SRE playbook on interpreting regression diffs (common flakiness patterns, signal vs noise, when to escalate). Share draft to the task in 4 days.
emily: ops-bot, create tracker items and add recurrence: bi-weekly regression triage (owner: oscar) and semi-annual chaos execution (owner: liam). Link back to postmortem.
ops-bot: Created tasks: TS-1001 (test-harness + scenarios) -> owner: oscar, due: 2026-04-10; TS-1002 (eviction prompt bank) -> owner: nora, due: 2026-04-06; TS-1003 (soak+runbook) -> owner: liam, due: 2026-04-08. Recurrences: bi-weekly regression triage (oscar), semi-annual chaos run (liam). Links: https://tasks.internal/TS-1001 https://tasks.internal/TS-1002 https://tasks.internal/TS-1003
nora: I'll tag high-sensitivity prompts (top-40) to gate weekly full sweeps; lower sensitivity ones go into nightly sampling.
oscar: Will add gating job that runs small scenario subset on PRs matching the globs. Also include a cost watch and an opt-out flag for infra emergencies.
aditi: I'll attach the SRE doc draft to TS-1001 and include a short quick-reference for oncall.
liam: Dry run scheduled Wed 2026-04-01 09:30 PT in staging. Invites sent to owners and ML reviewers.
emily: Summary: oscar (harness) due 2026-04-10, nora (prompt bank) due 2026-04-06, liam (soak+runbook) due 2026-04-08, aditi (SRE doc) due 2026-04-04. We'll reconvene after the dry run to lock thresholds and recurrence cadence. :white_check_mark:
